_approach: Wikipedia lists complextro among dariacore's EDM ingredients. Complextro's studio-edit stutter (the same hit repeated in a rapidly shortening burst, a glitch/gater effect) is approximated here as fast micro-repeats of the kick and clap on consecutive 16ths at descending velocity, breaking up an otherwise plain four-on-the-floor pulse — the 'edited within an inch of its life' feel dariacore inherits from complextro rather than from Jersey Club or breakcore. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
